title: Weizhuo Zhang
text: I’m Weizhuo Zhang and I’m from China. I lived in Canada for almost 7 years. I’ve graduated from U of A and got my Astrophysics Bachelor’s degree, and then spent 1 year in London, UK pursing my MSc Astrophysics degree. I’ve worked as a product analyst for mobile games which applied simple data analysis to help the teams to make the right decision. I also did some web events UI/mechanism design for our game. I hope that I can learn more about programming with Python & R, ML skills, and higher level data manipulating skills from the MDS program.

The data comes from the Palmer Penguins dataset, collected and made available by Dr. Kristen Gorman and the Palmer Station Long Term Ecological Research (LTER) Program. The data is available under a CC0 license.

library(palmerpenguins)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

title: Exploring Penguin Body Mass with R
text:
Data Cleaning
Clean the data before doing analysis

penguins_clean <- penguins |>
  filter(!is.na(species), !is.na(body_mass_g))

head(penguins_clean)

title: Exploring Penguin Body Mass with R
text:
Species Calculation
Calculate the body mass for each species

penguins |>
  group_by(species) |>
  summarise(mean_body_mass_g = mean(body_mass_g, na.rm = TRUE))

# A tibble: 3 × 2
  species   mean_body_mass_g
  <fct>                <dbl>
1 Adelie               3701.
2 Chinstrap            3733.
3 Gentoo               5076.

title: Exploring Penguin Body Mass with R
section: Figure of Body mass by species
text:
Figure of Body mass by species
Apply the figure to show the comparison of body mass from different species

ggplot(penguins_clean, aes(x = species, y = body_mass_g)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  labs(x = "Species", y = "Body mass (g)")







Figure 1: Body mass of penguins by species.





The fgiure shows the body mass distribution of three penguin species. From the figure, we can see that Adelie and Chinstrap have similar range of body masses, while Gentoo has a much higher overall distribution than the former two species.

title: My first weeks in MDS
text:
Orientation day on campus.


The orientation was great. I felt excited to meet new people with different backgrounds and amazing instructors as well.
The first week of MDS was stressful because we had many new courses, and because my background was a non-CS background so I had to load tons of new stuff into my brain.
The workload actually suprised me. I am aware that the MDS is a accelerated program, but I still need more effort to keep up the pace.
